_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Proposed Spare Parts List
summary: The Proposed Spare Parts List identifies the contractor's recommended spare parts required to maintain a system under a given set of circumstances and duration and will be used to determine spare parts stocking levels.
use_relationship:
The Proposed Spare Parts List identifies the contractor's recommended spare parts required to maintain a system under a given set of circumstances and duration and will be used to determine spare parts stocking levels.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
b. This DID supersedes DI-ILSS-80134A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Proposed Spare Parts List shall contain the contractor's recommended quantities of every type of spare part required for the system, to include all consumable and expendable items. This list shall explain any assumptions, formulas, or models used by the contractor in the creation of the list and shall include the following:

children.title: Prime manufacturer's or vendor's part number.
Unit of issue (e.g., each, feet, lot).
Recommended quantity to sustain operation for the time period and under the conditions stated in the contract.
Alpha numeric numbering of items on list.
Production lead time for each item
Explanatory narrative which describes the recommended quantity to take into account multiple end items at a single location.
